{
  "root_cause": "When Escape is pressed to close the dropdown menu, the dropdown hides but focus is not returned to the toggle button, causing focus to remain on the last active menu item or elsewhere.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the dataApiKeydownHandler in dropdown.js to call getToggleButton.focus() after instance.hide() when handling the Escape key, ensuring focus returns to the toggle after the menu closes.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing Escape will close the actions menu and move keyboard focus back to the Invoice actions toggle button, restoring a logical focus order for keyboard users.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If getToggleButton() returns null or a disabled element, focusing could fail or be ignored, but the preceding isDisabled check on the toggle mitigates this.",
    "Focusing the toggle may cause a scroll if the toggle is out of view, but the toggle is visible when the menu is open.",
    "No impact on mouse interactions or other keyboard shortcuts (ArrowDown, Enter, etc.) as the change is scoped to the Escape key path."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After opening the menu with ArrowDown and pressing Escape, the aria-expanded attribute on #actions-toggle must be 'false'.",
    "After pressing Escape, focus must be on #actions-toggle.",
    "The menu must be visually hidden (no .show class) after Escape.",
    "ArrowDown and Enter keys should still open the menu and select items as before.",
    "Clicking the toggle button or clicking outside the menu should still close the menu without unexpected focus changes.",
    "Escape press when the menu is already closed should leave focus unchanged and not throw errors."
  ],
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/src/dropdown.js",
      "sha256": "fc69a61b69ae1fa2c2bb923fdc393dd2742925e8af996376df5f98e38f8d810e",
      "before": "    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      return\n    }\n",
      "after": "    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      getToggleButton.focus()\n      return\n    }\n"
    }
  ]
}
